The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6c1ce1a87b049839), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For a unital C∗-algebra A, the follow- ing properties are equivalent. 1. Every bounded unital homomorphism π : A → B(H), on any Hilbert space H, is similar by a bounded invertible operator to a ∗-homomorphism. 2. For every faithful unital ∗-representation σ : A → B(K), on any Hilbert space K, every bounded linear map ∆ : A → B(K) satisfying ∆(ab) = ∆(a)σ(b) + σ(a)∆(b) has the form ∆(a) = Vσ(a) − σ(a)V for some V ∈ B(K).
